thread:
maria: Heads up — embeddings-backend returning 503s for a few enterprise customers since 15:02 UTC. Patch is ready: `embed-service:v2.1.3-hotfix`. We need expedited deploy, prefer skipping canary to avoid backlog. Requesting fast approvals from ops + release to push within 15m. @ops-oncall

deploybot: Automated checks:
• staging smoke: ✅
• perf: +2% median latency under load
• canary-skip requires two approvals (release-owner + ops)
Artifact: sha `abcdef123456`
Suggested windows: immediate (15m) or scheduled 11:00 maintenance.

alex: +1 from me. This is causing SLA hits, approve skip. :thumbsup:

sandeep: Quick ask — what's precise rollback criteria? Need clear thresholds before we skip canary.

maria: Rollback plan: immediate traffic shift to previous variant `v2.1.2` + disable quant path. Triggers: embed error rate > 1% over 2m OR p95 tail > 200ms sustained for 3m. Dashboard: https://dashboards/release/embed-hotfix (monitoring + alerts).

ops-oncall: I'll watch the rollout for 30m. Prefer canary but will ok skip if rollback automation is enabled. I approve.

jen: I'll prepare the brief release note for customers and internal postmortem stub. +1 from me.

sam: Confirming audit logs + deploy trace will be retained. Also make sure KMS access check is green.

deploybot: Approvals recorded: alex, ops-oncall, jen. Canary skip flag toggled. Beginning fastlane rollout in 5m. plan: eu-west1 -> us-east1 -> global.

maria: Starting rollout now. Strategy: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 2m observation windows. Watching `embed_success_rate`, `embed_error_rate`, p50/p95 latency.

deploybot: Stage 1 (20% eu-west1): success, no errors at this step.

sandeep: Noting a transient p95 bump in us-east when traffic shifted to new variant. Holding at 50%.

maria: Holding. If p95 > 1.2x baseline we will cut. Sam, have rollback runbook ready.

ops-oncall: We're seeing p95 at ~1.3x baseline and a small error uptick. Initiating rollback to `v2.1.2` in eu-west1 now.

deploybot: Rollback initiated — shifting 100% traffic back to `v2.1.2` in eu-west1.

maria: Rollback complete. eu-west1 back on `v2.1.2`. Root cause looks like a kv-cache miss amplification in the quantized codepath. Reverting hotfix deploy. Opening PR to revert quant changes and add an extra perf test.

jen: Release note updated to reflect rollback and customer impact. Will send internal comms and quick customer note for affected accounts.

alex: Thanks all. Marking this hotfix as blocked until the quant path is hardened. Postmortem + follow-up actions required.

sandeep: I'll own repro & fix for quantifier-edge-case. ETA for a guarded re-deploy is 4h after additional tests.

maria: Good. Closing this fastlane thread — we did the right thing to rollback. Follow-ups: PR link (to be attached), postmortem doc, and a retest plan before any re-rollout. :white_check_mark:
